  Unfortunately, Hawazen, you’ve not really focused on the main issue here – the
    diagnosis of adenocarcinoma and the test results that confirmed diagnosis.
  It is absolutely necessary to repeat your request at the end of the letter before
    finishing.
  You’ve focused a lot on the 08/02/14 – why ?
  There seems to be a lack of focus on what is essential, when really we should be
    summarising symptoms over the period and then giving detail on the investigations
    and diagnosis.
  Like I said for your last letter, you can write – and in this letter there are fewer
    grammar errors, which is good. Better organisation, better focus on purpose and
    you will make it to B.
    Grade: C+
